records.en_original: Huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...
records.en: Huh...

records.jp: （休み時間のたびに出て行ってるけど、<CR>どこに行ってるんだろう？）
records.en_original: (She leaves every time we get a break... Where does she go?)
records.en_auxiliary: (She leaves every time we get a break... Where does she go?)
records.en: (She leaves every time we get a break...<CR>Where does she go?)

records.jp: （この辺りだと思ったんだけど……）
records.en_original: (I think it was around here...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I think it was around here...)
records.en: (I think it was around here...)

records.jp: ここって……
records.en_original: This is it...
records.en_auxiliary: This is...
records.en: This place...

records.jp: おい
records.en_original: Hey.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey.
records.en: Hey.

records.jp: うわっ
records.en_original: Whoa!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa!
records.en: Whoa!

records.jp: なんだ、君か
records.en_original: Oh, it's you.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it's you.
records.en: Oh, it's you.

records.jp: 有理……。こんなところで何してるの？
records.en_original: Yuri... What are you doing here?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri... What are you doing here?
records.en: Yuri... What are you doing here?

records.jp: 侵入者が真っ先に誰何とか、いい度胸をしているな
records.en_original: Rather gutsy to be asking what I'm doing when you're the one bursting in here uninvited.
records.en_auxiliary: Rather gutsy to be asking what I'm doing when you're the one bursting in here uninvited.
records.en: Rather gutsy to be asking what I'm doing when you're the one bursting in here uninvited.

records.jp: ……が、まあいい。ここは私のラボだ
records.en_original: ...Well, no matter. This is my laboratory.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Well, no matter. This is my laboratory.
records.en: ...Well, no matter. This is my laboratory.

records.jp: ラボ？
records.en_original: Laboratory?
records.en_auxiliary: Laboratory?
records.en: Laboratory?

records.jp: 学校から専用に部屋を提供してもらっているんだ。<CR>あえて名乗るなら科学部室といったところかな
records.en_original: The school has set it aside for special use. I suppose you could call it the Science Club room.
records.en_auxiliary: The school has set it aside for special use. I suppose you could call it the science club room.
records.en: The school provided me with a room for my exclusive use.<CR>If I had to give it a name, I suppose it would be the Science Club room.

records.jp: 部員は私一人だがね
records.en_original: A club of which I am the only member.
records.en_auxiliary: A club of which I am the only member.
records.en: A club of which I am the only member.

records.jp: 学校から？　そんなこと、どうして……？
records.en_original: From the school? Why would they...?
records.en_auxiliary: From the school? Why would they...?
records.en: From the school? Why would they...?

records.jp: その雑誌
records.en_original: That journal.
records.en_auxiliary: That journal.
records.en: That journal.

records.jp: これ？
records.en_original: This?
records.en_auxiliary: This?
records.en: This?

records.jp: 科学雑誌だ。主に大学など研究機関の論文が載っている
records.en_original: It's a science journal. It mainly publishes papers from universities and research institutions.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a science journal. It mainly publishes papers from universities and research institutions.
records.en: It's a science journal. It mainly publishes papers from universities and research institutions.

records.jp: ……これがどうかしたの？
records.en_original: ...You're still not making any--
records.en_auxiliary: ...What about it?
records.en: ...What about it?

records.jp: １６ページからの論文
records.en_original: Page 16. Read the article.
records.en_auxiliary: Page 16. Read the article.
records.en: The paper starting on page 16.

records.jp: なにこれ……。<CR>英語だし、知らない単語が多すぎて全然わかんない
records.en_original: What is this...? It's all in English and these words are way too difficult for me to understand.
records.en_auxiliary: What is this...? It's all in English and these words are way too difficult for me to understand.
records.en: What is this...?<CR>It's in English, and there are far too many words I don't know.

records.jp: ウンルー輻射の実証実験に関する仮説だ。<CR>超高強度レーザーを用いた観測手法について言及している
records.en_original: It's a theory for proving Unruh radiation. It addresses a possible observation method using ultraintense lasers.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a theory for proving Unruh radiation. It addresses a possible observation method using ultra-intense lasers.
records.en: It's a hypothesis about an experiment to demonstrate Unruh radiation.<CR>It discusses an observation method using ultra-high-intensity lasers.

records.jp: この論文が理解できるからすごいってこと？
records.en_original: So, what? Are you saying you're so great because you can understand all that?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what? Are you saying you're so great because you can understand all that?
records.en: So, what? Are you saying you're so great because you can understand all that?

records.jp: 違う。その論文を私が書いたんだ
records.en_original: No. I'm saying I wrote that paper.
records.en_auxiliary: No. I'm saying I wrote that paper.
records.en: No. I'm saying I wrote that paper.

records.jp: ええ！？
records.en_original: What!?
records.en_auxiliary: What?!
records.en: What!?

records.jp: 子供の頃から物理と数学は得意でね。<CR>趣味と実益を兼ねて投稿を続けているんだ
records.en_original: I've been fond of physics and mathematics since I was young. I submit papers for fun and to gain practical experience.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been fond of physics and mathematics since I was young. I submit papers for fun and to gain practical experience.
records.en: I've been good at physics and mathematics since I was a child.<CR>I keep submitting papers partly as a hobby and partly for the practical benefits.

records.jp: そのあたりの実績が評価されて、<CR>学校から特別待遇を受けているというわけさ
records.en_original: The school held my papers in high regard, so and they've given me some special treatment.
records.en_auxiliary: The school held my papers in high regard, so they've given me some special treatment.
records.en: Those achievements were recognized,<CR>which is why the school gives me special treatment.

records.jp: 子供の頃からって……
records.en_original: You were submitting papers when you were a kid...?
records.en_auxiliary: You were submitting papers when you were a kid...?
records.en: Since you were a child...?

records.jp: （そっか。たしか有理はＩＱ３００の天才なんだっけ。<CR>けど――）
records.en_original: (Right. Yuri's supposed to be a genius with an IQ of 300. But still--)
records.en_auxiliary: (Right. Yuri's supposed to be a genius with an IQ of 300. But still—)
records.en: (Right. Yuri's supposed to be a genius with an IQ of 300.<CR>But still—)

records.jp: すごいのはよくわかったけど、どうしてこの高校に？
records.en_original: I understand that's great and all, but why are you here at this high school?
records.en_auxiliary: I understand that's great and all, but why are you here at this high school?
records.en: I understand that's great and all, but why are you here at this high school?

records.jp: 有理なら海外の大学に飛び級とかで入れそうだけど
records.en_original: With your brains, I'm sure nearly any university in the world would have accepted you...
records.en_auxiliary: With your brains, I'm sure nearly any university in the world would have accepted you...
records.en: With your intellect, it seems like you could skip grades and enter a university overseas.

records.jp: 研究のためだ
records.en_original: I'm here for my research.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm here for my research.
records.en: I'm here for my research.

records.jp: 研究……？
records.en_original: What's here to research?
records.en_auxiliary: Your research?
records.en: Research...?

records.jp: あまり表に出ている話ではないが、星ノ宮周辺では数年前から<CR>奇妙な時空の歪みが観測されているんだ
records.en_original: It hasn't been made public, but observations in the past few years suggest space-time distortion around Hoshinomiya.
records.en_auxiliary: It hasn't been made public, but observations in the past few years<CR>suggest space-time distortion around Hoshinomiya.
records.en: It isn't widely known, but strange distortions in space-time<CR>have been observed around Hoshinomiya for the past several years.

records.jp: 歪み……？
records.en_original: Distortion?
records.en_auxiliary: Distortion?
records.en: Distortion?

records.jp: 大型の加速器などでしか検知できない、ごく弱いズレだがね。<CR>確かにこの町だけ異様なエネルギーの変動が観測されている
records.en_original: It's only detectable by large-scale accelerators. But the energy fluctuations around this town are abnormal.
records.en_auxiliary: It's only detectable by large-scale accelerators, but the energy fluctuations around this town are abnormal.
records.en: The deviations are extremely slight—detectable only with something like a large accelerator.<CR>But abnormal energy fluctuations are unmistakably being observed in this town alone.

records.jp: そして、その歪みの中心にあるのがここ、星ノ宮女子高校だ
records.en_original: And at the heart of all of the distortions lies Hoshinomiya Girls' High School.
records.en_auxiliary: And at the heart of all of the distortions lies Hoshinomiya Girls' High School.
records.en: And at the heart of all of the distortions lies Hoshinomiya Girls' High School.

records.jp: それって……どういう？
records.en_original: What does that...mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What does that...mean?
records.en: What does that...mean?

records.jp: わからない。わからないからこそ調べているんだ
records.en_original: If I knew, I wouldn't be investigating.
records.en_auxiliary: If I knew, I wouldn't be investigating.
records.en: I don't know. That's precisely why I'm investigating.

records.jp: 今朝も観測装置のアラートを受けて駆けつけてきたが<CR>正体をつかむには至らなかった
records.en_original: I rushed here this morning because the distortion detector went off, but alas, I couldn't find the source.
records.en_auxiliary: I rushed here this morning because the distortion detector went off, but alas, I couldn't find the source.
records.en: I came running this morning after receiving an alert from my observation equipment,<CR>but I was unable to identify its source.

records.jp: ただ何か歪みの“根源”みたいなものがあるのは間違いない
records.en_original: However, I'm certain that there is, in fact, a source behind all of this.
records.en_auxiliary: However, I'm certain that there is, in fact, a source behind all of this.
records.en: However, I'm certain that there is, in fact, a source behind all of this.

records.jp: それが磁力や重力のような不可視の力場なのか、<CR>あるいは実体をもった存在なのかは分からないがね
records.en_original: It could be an invisible force akin to magnetism or gravity, or it could be some sort of tangible entity.
records.en_auxiliary: It could be an invisible force akin to magnetism or gravity, or it could be some sort of tangible entity.
records.en: It could be an invisible force akin to magnetism or gravity,<CR>or it could be some sort of tangible entity.

records.jp: ところで君
records.en_original: Well, now that I have you here.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, now that I have you here...
records.en: By the way...

records.jp: こちらも君に聞きたいことがある
records.en_original: I have something to ask of you.
records.en_auxiliary: I have something to ask of you.
records.en: There's something I want to ask you as well.

records.jp: 聞きたいこと？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: 司城夕月。司城来夢。<CR>あの二人は、いったい何者だ……？
records.en_original: Yuzuki Shijou. Raimu Shijou. What are they?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzuki Shijou. Lime Shijou. Just who are they?
records.en: Shijou Yuzuki. Shijou Lime.<CR>Just who are those two...?

records.jp: え？　どういう意味……？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you mean......?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What do you mean?
records.en: Huh? What do you mean...?

records.jp: 彼女たちのことを調べてみたが、過去の記録がまるでない。<CR>なのにいつの間にか、ごく自然にクラスに溶け込んでいる
records.en_original: I looked them up. couldn't find any past records about them. But somehow, they've infiltrated our class.
records.en_auxiliary: I looked them up, but I couldn't find any past records about them. Yet somehow, they've infiltrated our class.
records.en: I looked into them, but there are no records of their pasts at all.<CR>And yet, before anyone knew it, they had blended naturally into the class.

records.jp: しかも、そのことについて誰も違和感を抱いていない
records.en_original: Stranger still is the fact that they've done so unquestioned.
records.en_auxiliary: Stranger still is the fact that they've done so unquestioned.
records.en: And no one finds that strange.

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Oh, come on, that's...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, come on, that's...
records.en: That's...

records.jp: そもそも入学以来この学校、いや、あのクラスは変だ
records.en_original: Since the beginning of the school year, something's been wrong with this school. Our class in particular.
records.en_auxiliary: Since the beginning of the school year, something's been wrong with this school. Our class in particular.
records.en: Since the beginning of the school year, something's been wrong with this school. Our class in particular.

records.jp: 君はずっと休んでいたから知らないかもしれないがね
records.en_original: Perhaps you didn't notice, what with your extended absence.
records.en_auxiliary: Perhaps you didn't notice, what with your extended absence.
records.en: You've been absent all this time, so perhaps you don't know.

records.jp: 昨日、君が話していた盗難事件に限らず、不自然なくらい<CR>あのクラスでは事件や軋轢が起こっているんだよ
records.en_original: Even putting aside the thefts you mentioned yesterday, a high number of notable incidents have occurred in our class.
records.en_auxiliary: Even putting aside the thefts you mentioned yesterday, a high number of notable incidents have occurred in our class.
records.en: Not only the theft you mentioned yesterday—an unnatural number of incidents<CR>and conflicts have been occurring in that class.

records.jp: 誰かが故意に不和の種をばらまいているとしか思えない
records.en_original: It's as if someone is purposely scattering seeds of upset.
records.en_auxiliary: It's as if someone is purposely scattering seeds of chaos.
records.en: I can only conclude that someone is deliberately sowing seeds of discord.

records.jp: 故意にって……誰が？　なんのために？
records.en_original: Purposely...? Who would do that? To what end?
records.en_auxiliary: Purposely...? Who would do that? To what end?
records.en: Purposely...? Who would do that? To what end?

records.jp: 仮に、仮にだが、人間の感情の振幅が世界のゆがみを生み出し<CR>それによってエネルギーを得られるとしたら？
records.en_original: What if one could gain some sort of energy from the distortions caused by fluctuations in human emotions?
records.en_auxiliary: What if, hypothetically, one could gain some sort of energy from the distortions caused by fluctuations in human emotions?
records.en: Hypothetically, what if fluctuations in human emotions created distortions in the world,<CR>and someone could obtain energy from them?

records.jp: そのために誰かがあえて混乱や敵意を煽っているとしたら？
records.en_original: Wouldn't that be reason enough to cause discord?
records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't that be reason enough to cause discord?
records.en: What if someone were deliberately stirring up chaos and hostility for that purpose?

records.jp: まあ、自分でもおかしなことを言ってるのはわかっているがね
records.en_original: Of course, I'm entirely aware of how ridiculous what I'm saying sounds.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, I'm entirely aware of how ridiculous what I'm saying sounds.
records.en: Of course, I'm entirely aware of how ridiculous what I'm saying sounds.

records.jp: もし何か気づいたことがあったら教えてもらえないか
records.en_original: But would you mind telling me if you notice anything off?
records.en_auxiliary: But would you mind telling me if you notice anything off?
records.en: But would you mind telling me if you notice anything off?

records.jp: ……て、言われても
records.en_original: ...Like what?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Like what?
records.en: ...I wouldn't know what to tell you.

records.jp: 些細なことで構わないんだ。<CR>日常の、ちょっとした違和感や疑問があれば
records.en_original: It can be any sort of minor detail. Any suspicions you may have that something is out of place.
records.en_auxiliary: It can be any sort of minor detail. Any suspicions you may have that something is out of place.
records.en: It can be something trivial.<CR>Any little thing in everyday life that feels off or raises a question.

records.jp: ……うん、わかった
records.en_original: ...Sure, that's fine.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sure, that's fine.
records.en: ...Yeah, all right.

records.jp: じゃあフリスペの連絡先交換しようか？<CR>ともだち登録して
records.en_original: Why don't we exchange FreeSpace contacts? You can add me as a friend there.
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we exchange FreeSpace contacts, then? You can add me as a friend there.
records.en: Then why don't we exchange FreeSpace contacts?<CR>Add me as a friend.

records.jp: む、ともだち登録……
records.en_original: Hm. Adding a friend...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. Adding a friend...
records.en: Hm. Adding a friend...

records.jp: むむむ……？
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: もしかして、やり方がわからない？
records.en_original: ...Do you not know how?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Do you not know how?
records.en: ...Do you not know how?

records.jp: 普段はこういう機能を使わないからな……。<CR>仕方ない、私の端末からサーバーをクラッキングして――
records.en_original: I don't use these features... Blast it, it's a lost cause. I'll simply hack the server and--
records.en_auxiliary: I don't normally use these features... Blast it, it's a lost cause. I'll simply hack the server and—
records.en: I don't normally use functions like this...<CR>I suppose I'll have to hack the server from my device—

records.jp: ま、待って！　やり方教えるから！
records.en_original: N-No, no, no! I'll show you how!
records.en_auxiliary: N-no, no, no! I'll show you how!
records.en: N-No, no, no! I'll show you how!

records.jp: これで登録完了
records.en_original: There we go.
records.en_auxiliary: There we go.
records.en: Registration complete.

records.jp: ほら、友達のところに名前が出てるでしょ？
records.en_original: See? You can see my name under the Friends section.
records.en_auxiliary: See? You can see my name under the Friends section.
records.en: See? You can see my name under the Friends section.

records.jp: あ、そろそろ戻らないと
records.en_original: Oh, we need to go back soon.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, we need to go back soon.
records.en: Oh, we need to go back soon.

records.jp: 私は少し片づけをしてから戻る。先に行ってくれ
records.en_original: I'll return once I clean up. Go on ahead.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll return once I clean up. Go on ahead.
records.en: I'll return once I clean up. Go on ahead.

records.jp: そう？　わかった
records.en_original: Really? Okay then.
records.en_auxiliary: Really? Okay then.
records.en: Really? Okay then.

records.jp: ふむ……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 友達、か……
records.en_original: Friends, are we?
records.en_auxiliary: Friends, huh?
records.en: Friends, huh...
